mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jxc_payment (pay_no, target_type, target_id, pay_date, amount, pay_type, status, audit_by, audit_time, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{payNo}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{payDate}, #{amount}, #{payType}, '1', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO jxc_payment_item (payment_id, row_no, bill_type, bill_id, writeoff_amount, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{rowNo}, #{billType}, #{billId}, #{writeoffAmount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.payment_id AS paymentId, i.row_no AS rowNo, i.bill_type AS billType, i.bill_id AS billId, i.writeoff_amount AS writeoffAmount, CASE WHEN i.bill_type = '1' THEN pay.source_no ELSE rec.source_no END AS billNo FROM jxc_payment_item i LEFT JOIN jxc_payable pay ON i.bill_type = '1' AND i.bill_id = pay.id LEFT JOIN jxc_receivable rec ON i.bill_type = '2' AND i.bill_id = rec.id WHERE i.payment_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY i.row_no
SELECT id, supplier_id AS supplierId, source_no AS sourceNo, amount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, balance, status FROM jxc_payable WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, source_no AS sourceNo, amount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, balance, status FROM jxc_receivable WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE jxc_payable SET status = CASE WHEN balance - #{writeoffAmount} <= 0 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END, paid_amount = paid_amount + #{writeoffAmount}, balance = balance - #{writeoffAmount}, update_by = #{operName}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND balance >= #{writeoffAmount}

UPDATE jxc_receivable SET status = CASE WHEN balance - #{writeoffAmount} <= 0 THEN '2' ELSE '1' END, paid_amount = paid_amount + #{writeoffAmount}, balance = balance - #{writeoffAmount}, update_by = #{operName}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND balance >= #{writeoffAmount}
mapper.select: SELECT id, source_no AS sourceNo, source_type AS sourceType, amount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, balance, status, create_time AS createTime FROM jxc_payable WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND balance > 0 AND status != '2' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, source_no AS sourceNo, source_type AS sourceType, amount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, balance, status, create_time AS createTime FROM jxc_receivable WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND balance > 0 AND status != '2' ORDER BY id ASC
